wtfi.note.minecraft.water_bucket.obtain: Use an empty Bucket on a water source block.
wtfi.note.minecraft.lava_bucket.obtain: Use an empty Bucket on a lava source block. A cauldron under pointed dripstone below lava slowly fills with lava too.
wtfi.note.minecraft.milk_bucket.obtain: Use an empty Bucket on a Cow, Mooshroom or Goat.
wtfi.note.minecraft.powder_snow_bucket.o: Use an empty Bucket on Powder Snow (Groves and Snowy Slopes), or on a cauldron filled with powder snow during snowfall.
wtfi.note.minecraft.cod_bucket.obtain: Use a Water Bucket on a living Cod.
wtfi.note.minecraft.salmon_bucket.obtain: Use a Water Bucket on a living Salmon.
wtfi.note.minecraft.pufferfish_bucket.ob: Use a Water Bucket on a living Pufferfish.
wtfi.note.minecraft.tropical_fish_bucket: Use a Water Bucket on a living Tropical Fish.
wtfi.note.minecraft.axolotl_bucket.obtai: Use a Water Bucket on an Axolotl (Lush Caves).
wtfi.note.minecraft.tadpole_bucket.obtai: Use a Water Bucket on a Tadpole.
wtfi.note.minecraft.potion.obtain: Fill a Glass Bottle from water to get a Water Bottle, then brew it in a Brewing Stand. Witches also drop potions.
wtfi.note.minecraft.honey_bottle.obtain: Use a Glass Bottle on a full Beehive or Bee Nest (put a campfire under it so the bees stay calm).
wtfi.note.minecraft.honeycomb.obtain: Use Shears on a full Beehive or Bee Nest.
wtfi.note.minecraft.dragon_breath.obtain: Use a Glass Bottle on the purple cloud from the Ender Dragon's breath attack.
wtfi.note.minecraft.filled_map.obtain: Use an Empty Map. Cartographers and some chests also have explorer maps.
wtfi.note.minecraft.written_book.obtain: Write in a Book and Quill and sign it.
wtfi.note.minecraft.elytra.obtain: In an item frame on End Ships, which spawn next to some End Cities in the outer End islands. One per ship. Repair it with Phantom Membranes or Mending.
wtfi.note.minecraft.dragon_egg.obtain: Appears on top of the exit portal the first time the Ender Dragon is defeated. It teleports when hit: push it with a piston, or break the block under it and let it fall onto a torch.
wtfi.note.minecraft.dragon_head.obtain: Mounted on the bow of End Ships, next to some End Cities.
wtfi.note.minecraft.goat_horn.obtain: A Goat drops one when it rams a log, stone, packed ice, iron ore, copper ore or emerald ore. Pillager Outposts also have them.
wtfi.note.minecraft.wither_rose.obtain: Drops when any mob is killed by the Wither.
wtfi.note.minecraft.mud.obtain: Use a Water Bottle on Dirt, Coarse Dirt or Rooted Dirt. Also generates in Mangrove Swamps.
wtfi.note.minecraft.obsidian.obtain: Pour water over a lava source block, then mine it with a diamond or netherite pickaxe.
wtfi.note.minecraft.cobblestone.obtain: Mine stone, or make a cobblestone generator: lava flowing next to water.
wtfi.note.minecraft.basalt.obtain: Generates in Basalt Deltas, or forms when lava flows over Soul Soil next to Blue Ice.
wtfi.note.minecraft.clay.obtain: Mud placed above a block with Pointed Dripstone under it slowly turns into Clay.
wtfi.note.minecraft.ice.obtain: Water freezes in cold biomes. Mine with Silk Touch to keep it.
wtfi.note.minecraft.snow_block.obtain: Craft from Snowballs. Snow Golems leave snow trails you can collect.
wtfi.note.minecraft.exposed_copper.obtai: Copper blocks slowly oxidize when left in the world. Wax them with Honeycomb to stop it, or scrape with an Axe to go back a stage.
wtfi.note.minecraft.weathered_copper.obt: Copper blocks slowly oxidize when left in the world. Wax them with Honeycomb to stop it, or scrape with an Axe to go back a stage.
wtfi.note.minecraft.oxidized_copper.obta: Copper blocks slowly oxidize when left in the world. Wax them with Honeycomb to stop it, or scrape with an Axe to go back a stage.
wtfi.note.minecraft.white_concrete.obtai: Place Concrete Powder next to water (or let it fall into water).
wtfi.note.minecraft.enchanted_book.obtai: Put a Book in an Enchanting Table, find books in chests and fishing, or buy them from Librarians.
wtfi.note.minecraft.experience_bottle.ob: Buy from Cleric villagers, or find in some chests.
wtfi.note.minecraft.sponge.obtain: Elder Guardians drop Wet Sponge, and Ocean Monuments have sponge rooms. Dry Wet Sponge in a furnace or the Nether.
wtfi.note.minecraft.bell.obtain: Found in villages, or bought from Armorer, Toolsmith and Weaponsmith villagers.
wtfi.note.minecraft.nether_star.obtain: The Wither always drops one when killed. Summon it with 4 Soul Sand (or Soil) in a T shape and 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls on top.
wtfi.note.minecraft.ochre_froglight.obta: A temperate (orange) Frog eats a small Magma Cube. Temperate frogs grow from tadpoles in temperate biomes.
wtfi.note.minecraft.verdant_froglight.ob: A cold (green) Frog eats a small Magma Cube. Cold frogs grow from tadpoles in cold biomes.
wtfi.note.minecraft.pearlescent_frogligh: A warm (white) Frog eats a small Magma Cube. Warm frogs grow from tadpoles in warm biomes.
wtfi.note.minecraft.turtle_egg.obtain: Turtles lay eggs on sand after breeding (feed them Seagrass). Mine the eggs with Silk Touch.
wtfi.note.minecraft.torchflower.obtain: Plant Torchflower Seeds (dug up by Sniffers). When fully grown the crop turns into a Torchflower.
wtfi.note.minecraft.sculk_shrieker.obtai: Found in Ancient Cities, and placed by Sculk Catalysts when mobs die nearby. Mine with Silk Touch.
wtfi.note.minecraft.chipped_anvil.obtain: An Anvil gets chipped as you use it (12% chance per use).
wtfi.note.minecraft.damaged_anvil.obtain: A Chipped Anvil becomes damaged as you keep using it.
wtfi.note.minecraft.flow_pottery_sherd.o: Break Decorated Pots in Trial Chambers.
wtfi.note.minecraft.guster_pottery_sherd: Break Decorated Pots in Trial Chambers.
wtfi.note.minecraft.scrape_pottery_sherd: Break Decorated Pots in Trial Chambers.
wtfi.note.minecraft.tube_coral.obtain: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.brain_coral.obtain: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.bubble_coral.obtain: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.fire_coral.obtain: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.horn_coral.obtain: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.tube_coral_fan.obtai: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.brain_coral_fan.obta: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.bubble_coral_fan.obt: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.fire_coral_fan.obtai: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.horn_coral_fan.obtai: Grows on coral reefs in Warm Oceans. Mine with Silk Touch, and keep it in water or it dies.
wtfi.note.minecraft.bee_nest.obtain: Generates on some trees in plains, meadows, flower forests, sunflower plains and cherry groves. Mine with Silk Touch to keep it (and its bees).
wtfi.note.minecraft.bucket.use: Picks up water, lava, milk, powder snow and fish (with water).
wtfi.note.minecraft.glass_bottle.use: Fill from water for a Water Bottle, from a full beehive for Honey, or from the Ender Dragon's breath.
wtfi.note.minecraft.honeycomb.use: Use on copper blocks to wax them so they never oxidize. Also crafts candles and beehives.
wtfi.note.minecraft.bone_meal.use: Instantly grows crops, saplings and grass; makes flowers spread.
wtfi.note.minecraft.shears.use: Shears sheep, mines leaves/cobwebs/vines with drops, carves pumpkins, harvests honeycomb.
wtfi.note.minecraft.name_tag.use: Rename it in an anvil, then use it on a mob to name it. Named mobs never despawn.
wtfi.note.minecraft.lead.use: Leash animals and some mobs; tie them to fences.
wtfi.note.minecraft.saddle.use: Lets you ride horses, donkeys, mules, pigs, striders and camels.
wtfi.note.minecraft.ender_eye.use: Throw it to point toward the nearest Stronghold; place 12 in an End Portal frame to open it.
wtfi.note.minecraft.totem_of_undying.use: Hold it in either hand: when you would die, it saves you and gives Regeneration and Absorption.
wtfi.note.minecraft.flint_and_steel.use: Lights fires, Nether portals, TNT, candles and campfires.
wtfi.note.minecraft.water_bucket.use: Places water; stops falls; makes obsidian and cobblestone with lava; picks up fish.
wtfi.note.minecraft.compass.use: Points to world spawn, or to a Lodestone after being used on one.
wtfi.note.minecraft.recovery_compass.use: Points to where you last died.
